# EMEA invoices are issued from the shared ledger

## Decision Question

Where do EMEA invoices get issued once the regional ledger is retired?

## Decision Outcome

EMEA invoices are issued from the shared ledger starting in July.

## Alternatives Considered

- Keeping the regional ledger for one more quarter, ruled out on audit cost.

## Approved By

Ines Varga, at the 2026-06-03 billing review.
